Full SFT on mac MPS = ~168M params × backward + AdamW state = memory-bound. BATCH=2 grad_accum=8 (effective batch 16) chosen to share MPS memory with concurrent BG-JX (also full SFT). Gradient noise ratio higher; larger effective batch deferred to ubu1 cuda lane.

1500 steps mac MPS budget — full SFT typically converges in 5-50K steps for chat-cap. Eval at {0,500,1000,1500} samples early-trajectory convergence; if best_v58=0 and avg_loss decreasing, longer training deferred.

mac MPS RNG slight non-determinism vs train-cuda baseline; softmax/multinomial sampling routed through CPU float32 for stability. Per-eval seed reset (torch.manual_seed(42)) provides limited reproducibility.
V5.8 5 dialogues N=1 sample per eval — multi-seed (≥5) sweep deferred. Per-step v58_pass count is integer in [0,5].

Concurrent execution with BG-JX on same mac MPS — BATCH=2 chosen to share memory; nice 10 deferred (no nice-mode launch this iteration). MPS context-switching may slow per-step throughput vs solo run; wall-clock comparison vs BG-JX confounded by sharing.
V5.8 fact-recall PASS criteria reused as-is (case-insensitive substring + function word ≥1 + lev_ratio<0.85). No threshold adjustment for full-SFT model with explicit chat-template corpus.
